S.FORM: alang Kuli ga niya mki sku Toweng si atu Hosing Ku, kwara sali buwan nya ga 33 buwan, 130 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 95% kyan ku 124 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 5% kyan ku 6 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 86%, Amis 3%, Paywan 2%, Truku 2%, binah lihuyan s'uli 3%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kuli hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Kuli hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Kuli hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Kuli hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Kuli hya' ga rgyax Uruw. tay 'llaw na Kuli hya' ga Tkasan. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kuli ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku toweŋ [s|ɕ]i atu ħo[s|ɕ]iŋ ku kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** ami[s|ɕ] * pajwan * truku * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax uruw taj ʔllaw na kuli ħjaʔ ɣa tka[s|ɕ]an reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
